mapper.sql: id, master_id, sub_id, sku_id, sku_spec_snapshot, qty, price, amount, actual_qty
mapper.select: SELECT oi.id, oi.sub_id AS subId, ps.product_v2_id AS productId, oi.sku_id AS skuId, oi.sku_spec_snapshot AS skuSpecSnapshot, p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS productName, ps.color_name AS colorName, ps.size_name AS sizeName, oi.qty, oi.price, oi.amount FROM order_item oi LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON oi.sku_id = ps.id LEFT JOIN product_v2 p ON ps.product_v2_id = p.id WHERE oi.master_id = #{masterId} ORDER BY oi.sub_id ASC, oi.id ASC

SELECT oi.id, oi.sub_id AS subId, ps.product_v2_id AS productId, oi.sku_id AS skuId, oi.sku_spec_snapshot AS skuSpecSnapshot, p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS productName, ps.color_name AS colorName, ps.size_name AS sizeName, oi.qty, oi.price, oi.amount FROM order_item oi LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON oi.sku_id = ps.id LEFT JOIN product_v2 p ON ps.product_v2_id = p.id WHERE oi.sub_id = #{subId} ORDER BY oi.id ASC
